description: Count the fleeces that were skirted on an alpaca stud's herd register. DISTILL-CANARY-082b263b

files.README.md:
Cobble Hey Alpaca Stud - herd register

Work done with the herd is entered on the register as it happens, one line
for each visit, by whoever was in the pen that day. No line is entered for
two animals at once.

turns.prompt: Cobble Hey Alpaca Stud is making up the show entry list and needs the number of fleeces that were skirted, as the herd register records them. How many were there? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
